resolved_config.budget_gate: Equal two-panel average of phase3/4 M/B ratios;95% paired interval must lie wholly within[.95,1.05]. Per network, observation and domain separately. Generic point ratios weight archives equally using fixed inverse archive sample-size weights; bootstrap uses shared episode draws and those weights. Liu uniform weights. Do not infer all-cell or cross-domain matching from Ce generic matching.
resolved_config.calibration_gate: All four point ratios in[.95,1.05] per network. First2531 A/C pair first; if either fails, stop remaining calibration and all behavior. If first pair passes, finish other four calibrations regardless of failures, lock all results; behavior requires all6 pass. Solver failure is control infeasibility under fixed recipe, not proof no matching solution exists.
resolved_config.performance: Unchanged Ce five probability NI margins-.02 and inherited eight preservation flags are descriptive qualification, not substitutes for budget matching. No claim residual loss eliminated from nonsignificance or NI alone; report recovery/residual continuously, no new CE equivalence threshold.
resolved_config.primary: Ce generic-global CE residual M-B; positive95 lower bound means remaining loss, interpretable beyond matched mean phase budget only when Ce generic budget gate and task competence pass.
resolved_config.secondary: Ce generic-global CE recovery S-M; same paired draws. Report both contrasts in all4cells; raw candidate four-cell absolute performance, noise simple effects and training interactions; retain inherited competence, core and binding flags. Do not require compensation attenuation.
resolved_config.statistics: 2000 paired subject-ID bootstrap, seed126000+seed+panel*1000000; average the two fixed panels within each network; no pooling networks. Generic CE uses native raw signed margins; omitted probability uses original paired complete-case IDs.
resolved_config.stop: No retuning on panels2/3 or Liu. Failed evaluation budget check restricts interpretation but all prelocked24 outcomes are reported. No global constant, retraining, shuffled modulation or compact export branch.
